replies.full:
Hi Sanjog, 
Please find the responses below:
Q1. 
 Meesho Soap is ₹12.3 L against ₹22.4 L (55%). Pack of 2 is ₹6.9 L against ₹14.0 L, a gap of −₹7.1 L. Units per day are 126 against 302 last month (−58%). The reason is influencer/Meta gap: soap influencer/Meta spend has been shut down and we will not spend on-platform as the season is fading off, so we do not expect a recovery on this SKU. Regarding the discount, Meesho is reported on payout, not SP of product, so discount will always be above guideline.
Q2. 
 Flipkart Soap is ₹8.9 L against ₹18.3 L (49%). Pack of 2 is ₹5.4 L against ₹13.1 L, a gap of −₹7.7 L. Units per day are 93 against 184 last month (−49%). The reason is influencer/Meta: with soap influencer/Meta spend shut down, this trend of operating at 50% is what the brand expects overall level as well. 
Q3. 
 Due to "Flipkart and Seller" vs "Seller" vs "Flipkart" issue, products containing the 300ml shampoo SKU were marked as OOS for ~2 weeks (this has been cleared and fixed now). The combo has 30 units against 474 planned, and units per day are 1.4 against 41 last month. Spends and discounting have been adjusted for the campaigns with these SKUs to try and cover the gap. CVR % uptake due to discounting will be checked, and discounting actions will be reverted/normalised accordingly 
Q4. Face Wash ad spend is ₹2.0 L month to date against ₹39 K last month. The money was spent because the brand is rebuilding influencer/Meta on Face Wash, and ads were switched on to capture that demand. To catch up on the category's revenue, a campaign was turned on which burned money over the past weekend. This has been paused now.
Q5. Regarding the discount, Meesho is reported on payout, not SP of product, so discount will always be above guideline. No discount push has been given
Q6. Meesho Henna is ₹9.8 L against ₹5.7 L (172%). The beat is volume: Pack of 1 has 5,184 units against 3,158 planned. Ads on Henna are shut, so we believe this is influencer demand coming in. Regarding the discount, Meesho is reported on payout, not SP of product, so discount will always be above guideline.
